title: ApexOrgWideCoverage - Tooling API
description: Represents code coverage test results for an entire organization. Available in Tooling API version 29.0 and later.

PercentCovered.description: The percentage of the code in the organization that is covered by tests.

special_access_rules: In API version 49.0 and later, users must have the View Setup and Configuration permission to access this object.

        <xsd:element name="CreatedDate" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime" nillable="true"/>

        <xsd:element name="LastModifiedDate" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime" nillable="true"/>
